functional_requirements.name: Account creation
functional_requirements.description: Allow a user to create an account for a personal SmartBrew profile.
preconditions: The user has supplied the required registration details; the required fields remain to be defined.
postconditions: On successful registration, a personal account exists.

functional_requirements.name: User authentication
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to log in with credentials or an NFC/card tap and access their own profile.
inputs: User credentials or an NFC/card identifier
outputs: Access to the authenticated profile on success
preconditions: A matching account exists.
For card authentication, the presented identifier is associated with an account.
postconditions: Valid authentication gives access to the associated profile.
Invalid authentication does not grant profile access.

functional_requirements.name: Personal preference profiles
functional_requirements.description: Allow authenticated users to view and maintain their personal beverage preferences.
preconditions: The user is authenticated.
postconditions: Saved preference changes belong to the authenticated user's profile.

functional_requirements.name: Touchscreen menu and nutrition
functional_requirements.description: Provide touchscreen navigation through beverage categories and allow inspection of a beverage's nutritional information.
outputs: Nutritional information for the selected beverage
preconditions: Beverage catalogue and nutritional data are configured.
postconditions: The interface displays the selected category, beverage, or nutrition information.

functional_requirements.name: Interactive beverage customization
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to customize supported recipe parameters, including milk type, coffee strength, temperature, and syrup shots, and reflect changes in the current recipe while they interact.
preconditions: A beverage has been selected.
The requested parameter values are supported by the machine.
postconditions: The current recipe reflects the accepted customization values.

functional_requirements.name: Named personal recipes
functional_requirements.description: Allow authenticated users to save, name, and modify custom beverage recipes in their profile and select a saved recipe for one-touch ordering.
outputs: Order selection using the saved recipe
preconditions: The user is authenticated.
Modification or ordering requires an existing saved recipe.
postconditions: Saved changes are associated with the user's profile.
Selecting a saved recipe for ordering uses its stored customization values, subject to availability checks.

functional_requirements.name: Ingredient availability guard
functional_requirements.description: Prevent selection of a beverage when an ingredient it requires is depleted or below its configured minimum threshold.
outputs: Allowed selection or unavailable beverage indication
preconditions: Ingredient levels and minimum thresholds are available to the system.
postconditions: A beverage requiring a depleted or below-threshold ingredient cannot become a valid order selection.

functional_requirements.name: Beverage order execution
functional_requirements.description: Accept an available selected recipe as an order and coordinate payment and beverage preparation for that order.
outputs: Preparation instruction when the order is eligible to proceed
preconditions: The recipe passes ingredient availability checks.
Machine safety conditions allow preparation.
Payment acceptance follows the agreed online or offline policy.
postconditions: An eligible accepted order is submitted for preparation using its selected recipe.
An order blocked by payment or machine safety does not start preparation.

functional_requirements.name: Supported payment methods
functional_requirements.description: Support payment through credit/debit EMV chip and contactless cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and internal prepaid employee cards.
inputs: Payment processor or employee card result
preconditions: An order is awaiting payment.
The relevant reader and payment integration are configured.
postconditions: The order receives the payment outcome for the method used.
A rejected payment is not reported as accepted.

functional_requirements.name: Completed transaction history
functional_requirements.description: Automatically record every completed transaction, including the beverage customization parameters used, and associate it with the user's history when an authenticated user is identified.
preconditions: A transaction has reached the agreed completed state.
postconditions: The completed transaction and its customization values are available in transaction history.

functional_requirements.name: Digital receipts
functional_requirements.description: Offer a receipt for a completed transaction through a QR code scan or email, according to the user's choice.
inputs: Email address when email is selected
outputs: QR code providing receipt access or email receipt delivery result
preconditions: A completed transaction is available.
The selected delivery channel is available.
postconditions: The offered receipt corresponds to the completed transaction.
The selected delivery channel provides receipt access or reports its delivery outcome.

functional_requirements.name: Contextual drink recommendations
functional_requirements.description: Generate personalized drink recommendations using available profile preferences, historical user choices, time of day, and weather data.
outputs: Recommended drinks with calculated recommendation scores
preconditions: The recommendation service has beverage options to evaluate.
postconditions: The recommendation calculation uses the available specified context.
Unavailable external context does not prevent basic manual ordering.

functional_requirements.name: Mood-informed recipe suggestions
functional_requirements.description: Use the embedded camera to infer facial expression or mood and incorporate the inferred cue into tailored drink recipe suggestions.
preconditions: The camera is available.
Mood analysis operates under the agreed user permission policy.
postconditions: A successfully inferred mood cue is supplied to the suggestion calculation.
Captured facial images are handled according to NFR-01.

functional_requirements.name: Recommendation-based menu presentation
functional_requirements.description: Reorder and highlight touchscreen menu items according to calculated recommendation scores.
outputs: Reordered menu with highlighted recommended items
preconditions: Recommendation scores have been calculated for menu items.
postconditions: Menu ordering and highlighting reflect the configured score presentation rule.

functional_requirements.name: Protected maintenance access
functional_requirements.description: Provide an administrative mode reserved for maintenance personnel, accessible through a physical key, NFC master card, or technician PIN.
inputs: Physical key state, NFC master card, or technician PIN
preconditions: Maintenance authentication mechanisms are configured.
postconditions: Successful maintenance authentication grants administrative access.
Unsuccessful authentication does not grant administrative access.

functional_requirements.name: Ingredient refill registration
functional_requirements.description: Allow maintenance personnel to register physical ingredient refills, including milk, beans, cocoa, and cups, and reset the corresponding counters to configured maximum capacity.
preconditions: The operator has administrative access.
The corresponding ingredient has been physically refilled to maximum capacity.
postconditions: The selected ingredient counter equals its configured maximum capacity.

functional_requirements.name: Waste capacity monitoring and alerts
functional_requirements.description: Monitor liquid waste and coffee ground bin levels against capacity and alert maintenance personnel when disposal or emptying is required.
inputs: Configured bin capacities and alert thresholds
preconditions: Bin levels and configured capacities are available.
postconditions: A bin reaching its configured disposal threshold produces a corresponding technician alert.

functional_requirements.name: Overflow operation interlock
functional_requirements.description: Halt beverage preparation operations when liquid waste or coffee ground bin overflow is detected.
preconditions: Overflow is detected in either monitored bin.
postconditions: Preparation operations remain halted or blocked while overflow is active.

functional_requirements.name: Administrative error reporting
functional_requirements.description: Display current machine error messages on the administrative dashboard, including grinder jams, water heater faults, and low ingredient threshold conditions.
inputs: Machine fault and low ingredient events
preconditions: The machine reports an error condition.
The dashboard is accessible to authorized personnel.
postconditions: The dashboard identifies the reported error condition.

functional_requirements.name: Diagnostic event logs
functional_requirements.description: Record machine error events in event logs that support remote diagnostics.
outputs: Log access for authorized remote diagnostics when connected
preconditions: An error event has been reported.
postconditions: The reported error is represented in the diagnostic log without retaining facial images.

functional_requirements.name: Manual ordering during service outages
functional_requirements.description: When the network or an external service fails, retain basic manual beverage selection and customization using locally available machine functions and data.
inputs: Network or external service failure status
preconditions: The touchscreen, local control system, and required local menu data remain operational.
postconditions: Users can manually select an available beverage without a functioning weather or recommendation service.
Payment and preparation remain subject to the offline payment policy and machine safety conditions.

functional_requirements.name: Offline payment fallback
functional_requirements.description: Provide the specified fallback to offline card processing or cashless storage when network or external payment services fail; the permitted fallback and acceptance rules require stakeholder definition.
outputs: Offline payment outcome or unavailable payment indication
preconditions: The permitted offline mechanism and acceptance policy have been defined and configured.
postconditions: The order receives an explicit outcome under the approved offline policy.
A payment that has not been accepted is not represented as accepted.

functional_requirements.name: Optional local language agent
functional_requirements.description: When the optional local LLM module is installed and enabled, delegate user interaction and customization logic to a locally hosted model on the machine's embedded compute module.
inputs: Current menu and supported customization options
preconditions: The optional local LLM module is installed and enabled.
postconditions: The delegated interaction and customization logic executes on the embedded module.

functional_requirements.name: Optional natural language recipe requests
functional_requirements.description: When the local LLM module is enabled, translate free-form drink requests into explicit supported recipe parameters and machine instructions, subject to normal availability and safety checks.
outputs: Explicit supported recipe instructions or an unresolved-request response
preconditions: The optional local LLM module is enabled.
The machine's supported instructions and parameter ranges are available to the module.
postconditions: A resolved request produces explicit supported recipe parameters.
Instructions that fail machine constraints do not initiate preparation.

non_functional_requirements.description: Process captured facial images entirely in memory and immediately discard them after mood inference; do not store them locally or transmit them to external servers.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_criterion: During a camera inference test, no captured facial image is written to persistent storage or emitted in network traffic; the inference image buffers are released or cleared immediately after the inference step completes, including failure paths.

non_functional_requirements.description: Restrict maintenance functions to authenticated maintenance personnel.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_criterion: Attempts without valid maintenance authentication cannot invoke refill counter changes, access the administrative dashboard, or access remote diagnostic logs; each supported valid maintenance method permits its authorized local administrative access.

non_functional_requirements.description: Failure of network connectivity or an external service must not make basic local manual ordering unavailable.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_criterion: With network connectivity disabled, and separately with weather and payment service failures injected, manual category browsing, recipe selection, and supported customization remain usable. Payment outcomes follow the defined offline policy.

non_functional_requirements.description: Preserve the actual customization parameters in every completed transaction record.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_criterion: For each completed transaction in a test set covering supported customization parameters, the stored beverage and customization values match the executed order; no completed transaction in the test set lacks a record.

non_functional_requirements.description: Recommendation, saved-recipe, manual, and optional language-agent ordering paths must respect ingredient availability and overflow interlocks.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_criterion: For each enabled ordering path, tests with depleted or below-threshold required ingredients reject selection, and tests with active bin overflow do not start or continue beverage preparation.

non_functional_requirements.description: Provide an intuitive touchscreen interface for category browsing, nutritional inspection, and recipe customization.
Reflect recipe customization changes and machine error messages in real time on their respective interfaces.
Keep the optional local LLM feature separable from the basic touchscreen ordering system.
non_functional_requirements.measurable_criterion: With the local LLM module absent or disabled, standard menu browsing, manual customization, and the non-LLM ordering path remain available.

user_stories.goal: create and access my personal account using credentials or a linked card
user_stories.reason: keep my preferences and recipes available when I use SmartBrew
acceptance_criteria: Successful registration creates a personal account.
Valid credentials or an associated NFC/card identifier open the matching profile.
Invalid authentication does not grant profile access.
Saved preference changes are visible when the same profile is accessed again.

user_stories.goal: browse drink categories, inspect nutrition, and adjust a recipe on the touchscreen
user_stories.reason: choose a beverage that suits my preferences
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a category displays its beverages.
Inspecting a beverage displays its nutritional information.
Changing a supported customization value updates the current recipe.
A recipe requiring a depleted or below-threshold ingredient cannot be selected for ordering.

user_stories.goal: save and name my custom recipes and modify them later
user_stories.reason: reuse a preferred drink without entering its customization again
acceptance_criteria: Saving a named recipe associates its parameters with my profile.
Modifying a saved recipe changes the stored parameters.
One-touch selection uses the saved parameters and still checks ingredient availability.

user_stories.goal: order an available drink and pay using a supported cashless method
acceptance_criteria: EMV chip cards, contactless cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and prepaid employee cards have supported payment paths.
An accepted payment and a ready machine allow the selected recipe to proceed to preparation.
A rejected payment does not start preparation.
Every completed transaction records the beverage customization used.

user_stories.goal: choose a QR code or email receipt
user_stories.reason: retain a record of my completed transaction
acceptance_criteria: A completed transaction offers QR code and email receipt choices.
The chosen receipt refers to that transaction.
Email delivery uses the supplied or selected destination and reports the delivery outcome.

user_stories.goal: see drinks recommended from my preferences, history, and current context
user_stories.reason: find a suitable drink more easily
acceptance_criteria: The recommendation calculation accepts available preferences, history, time, and weather inputs.
Menu ordering and highlights follow the calculated scores and configured presentation rule.
Weather service failure leaves manual selection available.

user_stories.goal: receive a recipe suggestion informed by my facial expression without retaining my facial image
user_stories.reason: get a contextual suggestion while preserving image privacy
acceptance_criteria: A successful camera inference provides a mood cue to the suggestion calculation.
Camera image processing occurs entirely in memory.
Facial images are neither persisted nor sent to external servers.
Inference image buffers are discarded after processing, including on failure.

user_stories.reason: inspect and maintain the machine using authorized controls
acceptance_criteria: A configured physical key, NFC master card, or technician PIN can authorize maintenance access.
Invalid or missing maintenance authentication does not grant access to administrative controls.

user_stories.reason: make the system's ingredient counter reflect the refilled capacity
acceptance_criteria: Refill registration requires administrative access.
Registering a full refill sets the selected ingredient counter to its configured maximum.
Counters for other ingredients do not change as a result of that registration.

user_stories.goal: receive waste capacity alerts and have the machine stop on overflow
user_stories.reason: know when emptying is needed and avoid continued operation during overflow
acceptance_criteria: Both liquid waste and coffee ground bin levels are monitored.
A disposal threshold produces an alert for the corresponding bin.
Active overflow halts or blocks beverage preparation.

user_stories.goal: inspect current errors locally and diagnostic events remotely
user_stories.reason: identify conditions requiring repair or replenishment
acceptance_criteria: Reported grinder, heater, and low ingredient errors appear on the administrative dashboard.
Reported error events produce diagnostic log entries.
Authorized remote diagnostics can access those logs when connectivity is available.
Diagnostic logs do not contain captured facial images.

user_stories.role: beverage user during a connectivity outage
user_stories.goal: continue manually selecting and customizing a drink
user_stories.reason: use the machine's available local functions despite unavailable external services
acceptance_criteria: Network and weather service outages leave manual browsing and customization usable.
A payment service outage invokes the configured offline policy.
The interface receives an explicit payment outcome before an order is treated as accepted.

user_stories.role: beverage user with the optional local LLM enabled
user_stories.goal: describe a desired drink in natural language
user_stories.reason: express my preferences without choosing each recipe parameter manually
acceptance_criteria: The language model executes on the embedded machine module.
A resolved request becomes explicit supported recipe parameters.
Unresolved requests do not silently produce unsupported machine instructions.
Normal availability and safety checks still apply.
Disabling the optional module leaves manual ordering available.

product_backlog.name: Personal saved recipes

product_backlog.name: Ingredient availability checks

product_backlog.name: Order and preparation coordination

product_backlog.name: Cashless payment integrations

product_backlog.name: Transaction history and digital receipts

assumptions.description: This is an independent elicitation from smartbrew-spec only. assignment2_baseline.json was not read or used for this elicitation. IDs, requirement grouping, acceptance criteria, and backlog grouping are newly derived.

Priority labels describe source scope rather than business ranking: must denotes a stated non-optional capability or an essential derived constraint; optional denotes the explicitly optional local LLM feature. Delivery sequencing and business priorities remain unconfirmed.

All estimated_effort values are null because no team capacity, implementation baseline, estimation unit, or sizing evidence is provided. Usability and performance criteria are also null where stakeholder targets are absent.

A beverage catalogue, supported parameter ranges, ingredient capacities, thresholds, and nutritional data will be configured. The description does not supply their values or prescribe sensors versus estimated counters.

Order preparation is coordinated with an accepted payment and machine safety status. The exact payment, dispensing, completion, cancellation, and recovery lifecycle is not specified and needs agreement before implementation.

Card login requires an account-to-card association, and identified completed orders can be associated with that user's history. Card enrollment procedures and behavior for unidentified users remain undefined.

Resetting an ingredient counter to maximum assumes a physical full refill. Partial refill handling is unresolved. Threshold and overflow guards apply to every ordering path, including saved and LLM-generated recipes.

Graceful fallback is interpreted as preserving locally available manual selection and customization. It does not establish permission to dispense without accepted payment. No meaning or financial acceptance policy is invented for cashless storage.

Mood analysis requires a user permission policy to be agreed. Restricting remote diagnostics to authorized personnel, rejecting unsupported language-agent instructions, and preserving the actual executed recipe in history are derived constraints requiring stakeholder confirmation.

open_questions.question: Which registration fields and credential rules are required, how are cards linked or revoked, and how are sessions ended or timed out?
Can unidentified users order, and how should their transaction history, preferences, and recommendations be handled?
Which drinks, categories, customization ranges, ingredient consumption rules, and nutritional data sources are supported? Does nutrition update after customization?

How are prices and customization charges determined, when is payment accepted versus captured, and what constitutes a completed transaction? What happens after cancellation, preparation failure, or interruption?
What does offline card processing/cashless storage mean here? Which methods work offline, which transactions may be accepted, and how are pending transactions reconciled when service returns?
What user notice, consent, or opt-out behavior is required for camera mood analysis? May derived mood values be retained, and what happens if the camera fails or cannot infer a mood?
Which weather location and provider are used, how fresh must context be, how are scores and highlighting defined, and what recommendation quality criteria apply to new users or missing context?

What minimum ingredient thresholds, maximum capacities, waste alert points, overflow detection rules, and monitoring intervals apply? How are partial refills, bin emptying, and resumption after overflow registered?

What are the required response-time limits for customization, recommendations, dashboard errors, alerts, and overflow halting, and what touchscreen usability tasks and success criteria should be tested?
Which administrative actions and remote diagnostic users are permitted, how is remote access authenticated, and which event fields, retention periods, and offline logging behavior are required?
What information must receipts contain, how long should QR receipt access remain valid, and how should QR or email delivery behave during an outage?
Is the optional local LLM included in this release, what embedded compute limits apply, and how should ambiguous or unsupported natural language requests be resolved?
What stakeholder business priorities, delivery constraints, and estimation units should be used to rank and size the backlog?
